articles.title: Friday: Hili dialogue
articles.summary: The article, dated October 9, 2016, discusses the various popular names for America's long sandwiches, including Submarine, Hoagie, Hero, and Grinder. It also mentions exploring a Mexican version of this beloved food item. The piece delves into the diverse culinary nomenclature and regional interpretations of a common sandwich type, highlighting a cultural aspect of national eating habits.

articles.title: CBSE Date Sheet 2026 released for special exams; check complete schedule
articles.summary: CBSE has issued the Class 12 special examination date sheet for West Asian candidates. These exams, covering the earlier March-April session, are scheduled from October 23rd to 28th, 2026. Aspirants can download their admit cards starting October 12th, 2026. This initiative ensures students in the region can complete their academic year, reflecting the board's commitment to facilitating education for all its registered candidates.

articles.title: UK Opposition Party Proposes £10 Billion “Britannia Shield” Air and Missile Defence Plan
articles.summary: On Oct. 6, 2026, Opposition leader Kemi Badenoch unveiled plans for an integrated air and missile defence (IAMD) system for the nation. Announced in The Sun newspaper, this initiative aims to bolster national security by providing comprehensive protection against aerial and missile threats. This proposal signals a strategic focus on modernizing defence capabilities and ensuring preparedness against evolving security challenges.

articles.title: 50 Years on, Anne Rice’s ‘Interview With the Vampire’ Remains Immortal in San Francisco
articles.summary: Anne Rice's 1976 debut novel, 'Interview with the Vampire,' initially had a shaky start but eventually resonated deeply with readers. It took several years for Rice and her family to fully grasp the significant impact and growing success of the literary work, which would become a cultural phenomenon. This highlights how enduring cultural impacts can develop over time, transforming initial reception into widespread acclaim.

articles.title: Highlights from the Triple-I Initiative Showcase - October 2026 Edition
articles.summary: The Triple-I Initiative recently hosted a showcase, unveiling several new and innovative video games. This event serves as a key platform for developers to present upcoming titles, offering enthusiasts and industry observers a glimpse into potential future trends in digital entertainment and technology. It highlights the continuous evolution and innovation within the global gaming sector, reflecting advancements in design and interactive experiences.

articles.title: 5 Comic Supervillains Who Actually Have Good Motivations (and Two of Them Became a Heroes)
articles.summary: Supervillains are central to superhero comics' appeal, with Marvel and DC Comics recognized for creating iconic fictional antagonists. These villains, often inspired by pop culture, enhance narratives and challenge heroes, making them a crucial, fun part of comic book storytelling. They drive plots and provide compelling conflict, defining the superhero genre.

articles.title: Trial in killings of 3 US, Australian surfers in Mexico nears verdict
articles.summary: The trial for three men accused of murdering two Australian brothers and their American friend during a 2024 surfing trip to Mexico is in its final stage. The high-profile case, involving Jake and Callum Robinson and Jack Carter Rhoad, has garnered international attention and raised significant concerns about tourist safety in the region. A verdict for the accused is now pending.
